gecko.visible_surface_condition: smooth, nonporous, flexible pouch with slight wrinkling
evidence_used: soft/flexible pouch structure requiring controlled low normal force to avoid crushing
gecko.calculation_summary: Estimated base force = 2.0 N + 0.2 N compliance margin for flexible packaging = 2.2 N
assumptions_and_uncertainty: Assumes pouch can be flattened slightly against the rigid backing during grasp
Uncertainty in exact liquid content weight and local surface deformation
gecko.reasoning_trace: The gecko pads leverage the smooth, nonporous metallic foil surface to generate dry adhesion. However, because the pouch is soft and flexible, excessive normal force would deform the pouch body rather than forming a secure planar grip. A moderate normal force of 2.2 N provides sufficient preload for the gecko pads while maintaining structural integrity of the pouch.

silicone.visible_surface_condition: smooth, nonporous, flexible pouch with slight wrinkling
evidence_used: flexible package geometry requiring firm frictional hold
silicone.calculation_summary: Estimated base force = 2.5 N + 0.5 N friction and deformation adjustment = 3.0 N
assumptions_and_uncertainty: Assumes silicone pads achieve stable friction against the pouch laminate
Uncertainty regarding internal fluid shifting during lift
silicone.reasoning_trace: The high-friction silicone pads rely primarily on normal force and friction to secure the object. Since the foil pouch is flexible and relatively light, a normal force of 3.0 N ensures adequate frictional engagement without crushing the liquid-filled container.

comparison_evidence: Flexible foil pouch material and slight surface wrinkling favor silicone compliance over rigid gecko backing requirements
Silicone gripper accommodates minor pouch deformation more robustly than flat gecko pads
recommendation_summary: Both grippers are capable of handling the flexible pouch. The silicone gripper is recommended because its high-friction pads and local compliance adapt better to the slightly irregular, deformable surface of the juice pouch compared to the rigid backing requirements of the gecko gripper.
